answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37750 Country: India Title: What is Haram Question: What is Haram? What is gunah? What are the differences between these two? Answer ID: 37750 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 620/620/M=1433) Shariah commandments are of two kinds: (1) Mamurat: (orders which we are asked to obey). (2) Manhiyat: (prohibitions which we are asked to avoid). Haram is the high status of prohibition and sin is its result. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
